g.text: One frame, from the firmware to ClickHouse
Frame 41 leaves the firmware over UART
The gateway checks its CRC and sequence, then publishes it
Spate polls the partition and decodes the frame into a row
Spate inserts the batch into ClickHouse
ClickHouse confirms the batch is durable
Only then does Spate commit the offset, so a crash can repeat work but never skip it
